hints.outputs: Use builds[].targets plus a build-level output template; include {ext} for platform executable extensions.
hints.consumers: Consumer wiring was removed; publish sections select artifacts with catalog filters and optional ids.
hints.downloadUrl: Download URLs are derived from publish.github.repository or supplied as a section-level catalog URL.
hints.$.project.package: Use project.packageName for package identity, or publish.npm.packageName for npm publishing.
hints.$.strict: Strict mode was removed; reviewable operations now encode validation behavior directly.
hints.$.npmPackage.id: The npm package artifact id is fixed as npm-package.
hints.$.publish.npm.trustedPublishing.packageE: Use verifyPackageExists for the optional read-only npm package existence check.
hints.$.publish.homebrew.artifactId: Use artifactIds with one or more artifact IDs.
